fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Paul Lenda is an author and mindfulness guide, who has been residing in Laos during the 2020 lockdowns. He's the founder of websites like SHIFT and The Uplift Guide, and he wrote a great book called The Creation of a Consciousness Shift. Join us for a conversation about attaining our highest evolutionary potentials, contacting spiritual guides, cultivating awareness to find truth, and much more.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Two Roads Past the Human Body", "body": "Paul lays out what he sees as a fork in human evolution. One road is the synthetic merger promoted by transhumanists like Zoltan Istvan, moving from nanodust to neural chips to new containers for the ego personality, with a kill switch built into an AI mainframe that a coronal mass ejection could knock out. The other is organic and intentional, pointing to the rainbow body and Sri Aurobindo's supramental transformation. In his view an uploaded copy is never really you, and he describes plans for schools, like an X-Men academy, to help people develop psychic abilities while that window is still open."}, {"title": "Consciousness Is Feeling, Not Data", "body": "Chance argues that consciousness is feeling, so any claim that artificial consciousness feels as much or more is immediately suspect. He suggests much of transhumanism's pull comes from people who find being in their own bodies uncomfortable, then connects the movement to video games like Cyberpunk 2077 and Deus Ex, where life becomes an endless virtual game. From there he unpacks identity as an id entity, calls each of us 99% ancestor and 1% unique, and names the real spiritual war as artificiality versus reality. Paul adds that fear of dying, which Jason Silva openly admits, draws many people toward uploading."}, {"title": "The Demiurge Behind Simulation Theory", "body": "Chance traces modern simulation theory back to a corrupted strand of Gnostic thought, where a demiurge builds an artificial prison and planetary archons keep souls inside it, and argues that any such story quietly degrades the body and nature. He wonders whether elites pursue transhumanism to escape karmic review. Paul answers that people high in the blue bloods, as he puts it, hold beliefs close to that, some convinced their negative roles serve a greater good. He counters the prison view by calling dense reality a sandbox where source, a kind of supra-organism, experiences itself through countless nodes of consciousness."}, {"title": "Energetic Hygiene and the Power of No", "body": "Paul holds that nothing happens to you without some level of agreement, so an attack becomes a teacher pointing to a weak spot in your auric field before small openings grow larger. Chance compares music festivals to a whole lifetime in a weekend, where unconscious people can latch onto a group, and calls energy hygiene more important than showering, though a shower with intention helps carry away discharge. Paul describes staying centered during a hostile encounter involving police by visualizing his team. Chance ties this to Neo's first word, no, as the missing sacred masculine, and to how a weaker field entrains to a stronger one."}, {"title": "I Ching, Number Systems and Gematria", "body": "Paul explains how he met the I Ching through Terence McKenna's Time Wave Zero, notes that Confucius said he would need another lifetime to understand it, and describes throwing large coins for open questions and finding its answers diagnostic rather than simply good or bad. Chance reads the 64 hexagrams as eight times eight, echoed in chessboards, 64-bit computing and DNA codons. Paul suggests other civilizations count in base six, eight or nine, and links our base ten to ten fingers. Chance then shares gematria matches such as virtual world and consciousness, and recommends the Gematrinator calculator while warning against the rabbit hole."}]

But 1% of infinity is huge.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Nothing can ever just happen to you without you, in some way, agreeing to that happening.", "author": "Paul Lenda", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "The actual spiritual war is artificiality versus reality.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The way that the I Ching explains things is very diagnostic, and it's not all good or all bad.", "author": "Paul Lenda", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "I think the energy hygiene is a very subtle part of the reality, but it's more important than showering.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When we know who we are, then we're less likely to be hijacked, co-opted, or tacitly agreeing to realities that do not have our best interests or our sovereignty in mind.", "author": "Paul Lenda", "portrait": ""}, {"text": "What fear does is tries to restrict the outcome of everything it can and control it down to one outcome because it's afraid of the other potential outcomes.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
